about_the_game:
Come aboard and discover life on the water in Animal Aboard!

Turn a damaged ship into a floating dream home and embark on a challenging journey! In Animal Aboard, you play the role of a captain, designer and handyman who every day discovers new ways to improve your life at sea. Your goal is not just to travel, but to create the perfect place for you and your faithful companion.

Destroyed, non-functional rooms? No problem, Set up furniture like a bathtub or a piano, knock down walls with a big hammer, renovate interiors to turn the ship into a cozy place according to your tastes.

A real garden can flourish on your ship! Grow plants, protect them from insect pests with special potions and watch your floating home transform into a green oasis. Each element requires your care - maybe you can create a growth potion?

Your faithful companion is your dog. Every moment you spend together strengthens your relationship, and your goal is to create the perfect place for him as well. Build him his own corner on the ship and go on new adventures together!

Are you ready to take the wheel and create your own life at the galas? Join the adventure in Anima Aboard!

Key Features:

Building and decorating - rebuild your ship, set up furniture, knock down walls with a hammer, turn your boat into a floating home

Gardening on board - grow plants, use special potions and create a green oasis on the sea

Cleaning and housekeeping - remove puddles, vacuum the deck, chase away uninvited guests so that your ship always shines

Dog companion - take care of your companion and discover ways to live together at sea

Creative challenges - create, experiment and change the ship's space by making daily decisions and new challenges
